integrity: The infinite-size formula is proved by a complete two-time-layer correspondence, cycle decomposition, and a four-state transfer matrix. The code independently checks finite instances. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact labelled recurrent states and least-period-two orbits only, not basin populations or first-entry times. Finite checks do not replace the proof; unindexed historical equivalence remains possible.
title: A parity-factorized periodic-orbit census for majority dynamics on sunlet graphs
